messages:
Alex Kim: Heads-up — Friday deploy wave at 09:00 PT. Owners below. Need smoke owners + rollback snippets by EOD so we can lock the train. Quick list: api-gw -> @Priya, runtime-service -> @Jamal, model-router -> @Mia, console -> @Sam. Run window 09:00-10:30 PT. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/runs/2026/q1/wave-14
Priya Patel: Confirmed for api-gw. I’ll own smoke (api-health, auth-check, quick e2e). Rollback plan: re-point traffic to stable LB and revert image tag. Command I’ll use: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-gw --to-revision=3```
Jamal Turner: I can take runtime-service but prefer 09:30 PT slot — can swap with Sam? runtime has longer warmups.
Sam Ortiz: fine to swap, I can move console to 09:30. Sam will still be on-call for any UI flakiness.
Mia Chen: model-router ok at 09:00 but request canary (10%) first 10m. I’ll monitor model-load errors and kv cache warmup. Canary rollback triggers: error rate >2% or p95 latency >600ms for 5m.
Priya Patel: @Alex noted — I’ll post smoke pass/fail in this thread and tag #incidents if any fail. Smoke checklist: 1) GET /health 2) sign-in 3) sample-gen 4) token billing check.
deploy-bot: Reservation created: wave-14 window 2026-03-27 16:00-17:30 UTC (09:00-10:30 PT). Reminder will post 30m before start.
Alex Kim: Thanks. @Jamal add the warmup command and snapshot link here when you have it. @Mia please paste canary rollout snippet.
Jamal Turner: Warmup command: ```curl -X POST https://runtime.internal/warmup -d '{"model":"gptx"}'``` I’ll push perf snapshots to https://perf.redwood/2026/wave14/runtime by EOD and stay +1h after deploy.
Mia Chen: Canary rollout snippet: ```kubectl set image deployment/model-router model-router=registry/redwood/model-router:wave14-canary --record && kubectl patch svc model-router -p '{"spec":{"traffic":{"canary":10}}}'``` If canary fails I’ll run: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-router```
Sam Ortiz: Console rollback: revert commit in CI and hit promote-stable job (Jenkins). Smoke script: `/ops/smoke/console-smoke.sh` — will run post-deploy and post any CDN purge.
Alex Kim: Perfect. Current confirmed roster: Priya (api-gw, smoke), Mia (model-router canary), Jamal (runtime-service 09:30), Sam (console 09:30). I’ll update the release doc and mark owners in the Console. If anyone needs to swap after EOD ping me here.
Priya Patel: One more note — I’ll enable circuit-breaker low-threshold during the first 15m for api-gw (helps protect backend).
Alex Kim: All right — closing confirmations. See you Friday; I’ll post 30m reminder. :thumbsup:
